nieuw.titel: Do not dismiss powerful spells because of low casting odds
nieuw.tekst: Do not rule out casting a powerful 10+ spell just because its chance of resolving through a dispel attempt is only around 30 to 40 percent.
nieuw.waarom: He says the expected value of a spell such as Spiritual Vortex can still be enormous and might win the game.

bronnen.citaat: does that mean you shouldn't cast these spells? Well, not at all.

nieuw.titel: Invest in a wizard for repeatable magical defence
nieuw.tekst: He thinks a level-three dispeller is worth taking if it comes cheaply or at little cost to the army. Even a level-one or level-two wizard is worth considering for repeated dispel attempts rather than relying only on a fated dispel.
nieuw.waarom: In his view, the dispeller has the advantage in a casting contest. He values the level-three wizard's extra six inches of dispel range and notes that a fated dispel is limited to one per turn.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: His recommendation to invest in magical defence is conditional on being able to fit it into the army at little cost.

bronnen.citaat: having a level three dispeller, if you can get that cheaply

extraCitaten.citaat: that 6 in in the bubble is a big deal

nieuw.titel: Keep a protected dispeller near the centre
nieuw.tekst: Position a defensive wizard centrally, in or near a friendly unit, to spread its dispel bubble over the board. For a combat army that wants little investment in magic, he recommends at least a level-one wizard in the central infantry unit.
nieuw.waarom: He says a central dispeller restricts the opponent's casting without needing the line of sight or vision arcs a caster may require. A wizard close behind a matching unit type can also benefit from the lone-character targeting restrictions he describes.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He says central positioning makes the wizard more vulnerable. Cannons are a concern for a wizard outside a unit, so joining a unit for Look Out, Sir may be safer.

bronnen.citaat: a dispeller who can be in a unit or around a unit centrally

extraCitaten.citaat: have a level one at a minimum in that central infantry unit

nieuw.titel: Start outside dispel range for opening spells
nieuw.tekst: Use a starting position outside the opposing wizard's dispel range to cast first-turn spells before moving into its bubble.
nieuw.waarom: He says starting outside the bubble lets the first player cast without facing a wizardly dispel.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He notes that a fated dispel can still be available.

bronnen.citaat: if you start on that first turn outside of dispel range

extraCitaten.citaat: before your opponent had a chance to dispel

nieuw.titel: Keep buffing wizards back beyond enemy dispel range
nieuw.tekst: Keep a wizard casting buffs or movement spells outside the enemy dispel bubble but within spell range of your troops. Consider deploying farther back to make this possible, especially against an opponent equipped to shut down your magic.
nieuw.waarom: He says the wizard can still target friendly units while the enemy dispeller is too far away to intervene.
nieuw.voorbeeld: For Vampire Counts relying on Hellish Vigor to get troops moving, he would park the wizard behind the troops and outside the bubble.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He says characters deploying last can make it difficult to know the opposing wizard's position. He also warns that a second Walk Between Worlds cast inside the bubble may fail when trying to create an anvil or set up combat.

nieuw.titel: Favour enchantments and conveyances for higher-level supporting wizards
nieuw.tekst: He favours using higher-level wizards for enchantments and conveyance spells, supporting the army from the rear.

nieuw.titel: Consider Power Scrolls for hexes and vortexes inside the bubble
nieuw.tekst: When casting hexes or vortexes requires entering enemy dispel range, consider Power Scrolls to improve the chance of beating the dispel.
nieuw.waarom: He says these spells require entering the bubble, where the opponent can contest the cast.

nieuw.titel: Engage the enemy wizard before casting a crucial spell
nieuw.tekst: If your army relies heavily on a spell such as Spectral Doppelganger, consider expendable fast troops to charge and engage the enemy wizard before casting. He finds that flyers are usually needed to reach the wizard.
nieuw.waarom: He says engaging the wizard switches off its dispel bubble, allowing you to cast before the attacking troops die.
nieuw.wanneerNiet: He says this can be difficult, particularly when a lone wizard is protected from charges. Flyers help obtain line of sight and cross intervening troops; Dire Wolves or fast cavalry in open order find the approach harder.
